CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) characters are preserved

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>中文内容</p><p>日本語テキスト</p><p>한국어 텍스트</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result)
```
